vendor_highlights: Released Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental for public preview.

changelog.text:
*     The following Gemini 2.0 models are now [shut down](/docs/deprecations):

  *   `gemini-2.0-flash`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-001`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001`

  Use [`gemini-3.5-flash`](/docs/models/gemini-3.5-flash) or
  [`gemini-3.1-flash-lite`](/docs/models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite) instead.

*     Deprecation announcement: The following models will be [shut
  down](/docs/deprecations) June 1, 2026:

  *   `gemini-2.0-flash`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-001`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001`

*   Released [URL context tool](/docs/url-context) to general availability (GA),
  a tool for providing URLs as additional context to prompts. Support for
  using URL context with the `gemini-2.0-flash` model (available during
  experimental release) will be discontinued in one week.

*     Launched an experimental [Gemini 2.0 Flash](/docs/image-generation)
  model capable of image generation and editing.

*     Released `gemini-2.0-flash-001`, a generally available (GA) version of
  [Gemini 2.0 Flash](/docs/models) that supports text-only
  output.

*   Released `gemini-2.0-flash-thinking-exp-01-21`, the latest preview version
  of the model behind the [Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Model](/docs/thinking).

*     Released Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Mode for public preview. Thinking Mode is
  a test-time compute model that lets you see the model's thought process
  while it generates a response, and produces responses with stronger
  reasoning capabilities.

  Read more about Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Mode in our [overview
  page](/docs/thinking).

*     Released [Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental](/docs/models) for
  public preview. Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental's partial list of features
  includes:

  *   Twice as fast as Gemini 1.5 Pro
  *   Bidirectional streaming with our Live API
  *   Multimodal response generation in the form of text, images, and speech
  *   Built-in tool use with multi-turn reasoning to use features like code
    execution, Search, function calling, and more


Read more about Gemini 2.0 Flash in our [overview page](/docs/models).
